goal: Warn users with accurate required disk space on first startup
Stop pruned nodes from incorrectly warning that they need full chain storage
Fix unit discrepancies by reporting needed space in GiB instead of GB
agreement: Strong support with all earlier concerns resolved
Verified math discrepancy between silent checks and UI display (mercie-ux)
Tested that pruned nodes warn for actual needed space instead of full chain size (jeanpablojp)
Approved keeping internal units in GiB while correcting user-facing strings (achow101, murchandamus)
Resolved objection: accepted keeping GiB units despite MiB prune granularity (hebasto)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes misleading startup disk warnings for pruned nodes
Prevents users running pruned configurations from being falsely told they lack hundreds of gigabytes
